checks: Saved source-contract consistency; public split mean-domain and moment reconstruction; selective retrospective evidence hashes.
Proposed host C object sizes and arithmetic against declared10032B complete planning budget; target reserves remain unmeasured.
Independent design, transaction, evidence-cursor and qualification review; preserve all prior tracked files except current navigation/state.
stop: Freeze one design and next-test contract after these finite read-only evidence/layout checks. No implementation or primary comparison in this design study.

limits: An executable layout declaration is not a learner implementation or complete target memory measurement; endpoint equation evaluation is not inference or a trajectory replay.
